verses.original: קְרָ֤א בְגָרוֹן֙ אַל־ תַּחְשֹׂ֔ךְ כַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר הָרֵ֣ם קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְהַגֵּ֤ד לְעַמִּי֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔ם וּלְבֵ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב חַטֹּאתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qə·rā ḇə·ḡā·rō·wn ’al- taḥ·śōḵ kaš·šō·w·p̄ār hā·rêm qō·w·le·ḵā wə·hag·gêḏ lə·‘am·mî piš·‘ām ū·lə·ḇêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: Cry aloud do not hold back Raise your voice like a ram’s horn Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins
verses.literalPt: Clama em alta voz, não cesses, levanta como trombeta a tua voz e anuncia ao meu povo a sua transgressão e à casa de Jacó, os seus pecados.

verses.original: וְאוֹתִ֗י י֥וֹם יוֹם֙ יִדְרֹשׁ֔וּן וְדַ֥עַת דְּרָכַ֖י יֶחְפָּצ֑וּן כְּג֞וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ צְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה וּמִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱלֹהָיו֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔ב יִשְׁאָל֙וּנִי֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵי־ צֶ֔דֶק קִרְבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֶחְפָּצֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·w·ṯî yō·wm yō·wm yiḏ·rō·šūn wə·ḏa·‘aṯ də·rā·ḵay yeḥ·pā·ṣūn kə·ḡō·w ’ă·šer- ṣə·ḏā·qāh ‘ā·śāh ū·miš·paṭ ’ĕ·lō·hāw lō ‘ā·zāḇ yiš·’ā·lū·nî miš·pə·ṭê- ṣe·ḏeq qir·ḇaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm yeḥ·pā·ṣūn
verses.literal: For day after day they seek Me and delight to know My ways like a nation that does what is right and does not forsake the justice of their God They ask Me for righteous judgments they delight in the nearness of God
verses.literalPt: Contudo, me buscam cada dia e têm prazer em conhecerem os meus caminhos; como uma nação que praticou a justiça e não abandonou o juízo do seu Deus, pedem-me juízos retos, têm prazer em se chegarem a Deus.

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה צַּ֙מְנוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א רָאִ֔יתָ עִנִּ֥ינוּ נַפְשֵׁ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א תֵדָ֑ע הֵ֣ן בְּי֤וֹם צֹֽמְכֶם֙ תִּמְצְאוּ־ חֵ֔פֶץ וְכָל־ עַצְּבֵיכֶ֖ם תִּנְגֹּֽשׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṣam·nū wə·lō rā·’î·ṯā ‘in·nî·nū nap̄·šê·nū wə·lō ṯê·ḏā‘ hên bə·yō·wm ṣō·mə·ḵem tim·ṣə·’ū- ḥê·p̄eṣ wə·ḵāl ‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇê·ḵem tin·gō·śū
verses.literal: Why have we fasted and You have not seen Why have we humbled ourselves and You have not noticed Behold on the day of your fast you do as you please and you oppress all your workers
verses.literalPt: Por que temos nós jejuado, dizem eles, e tu não atentas? Por que temos afligido as nossas almas, e tu não o sabes? Eis que, no dia do vosso jejum, prosseguis as vossas empresas e exigis que se façam todos os vossos trabalhos.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן לְרִ֤יב וּמַצָּה֙ תָּצ֔וּמוּ וּלְהַכּ֖וֹת בְּאֶגְרֹ֣ף רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־ תָצ֣וּמוּ כַיּ֔וֹם לְהַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּמָּר֖וֹם קוֹלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hên lə·rîḇ ū·maṣ·ṣāh tā·ṣū·mū ū·lə·hak·kō·wṯ bə·’eḡ·rōp̄ re·ša‘ lō- ṯā·ṣū·mū ḵay·yō·wm lə·haš·mî·a‘ bam·mā·rō·wm qō·wl·ḵem
verses.literal: You fast with contention and strife to strike viciously with your fist You cannot fast as you do today and have your voice be heard on high
verses.literalPt: Eis que jejuais para contendas e rixas e para ferirdes com punho iníquo; não jejuais hoje, de maneira que a vossa voz se faça ouvir no alto.

verses.original: הֲכָזֶ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה֙ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵ֔הוּ י֛וֹם עַנּ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם נַפְשׁ֑וֹ הֲלָכֹ֨ף כְּאַגְמֹ֜ן רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וְשַׂ֤ק וָאֵ֙פֶר֙ יַצִּ֔יעַ הֲלָזֶה֙ תִּקְרָא־ צ֔וֹם וְי֥וֹם רָצ֖וֹן לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḵā·zeh yih·yeh ṣō·wm ’eḇ·ḥā·rê·hū yō·wm ‘an·nō·wṯ ’ā·ḏām nap̄·šōw hă·lā·ḵōp̄ kə·’aḡ·mōn rō·šōw wə·śaq wā·’ê·p̄er yaṣ·ṣî·a‘ hă·lā·zeh tiq·rā- ṣō·wm wə·yō·wm rā·ṣō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: Is this the fast I have chosen a day for a man to deny himself to bow his head like a reed and to spread out sackcloth and ashes Will you call this a fast and a day acceptable to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Acaso, pode tal jejum ser o que escolhi? O dia em que o homem humilha a sua alma? Consiste, porventura, em inclinar o homem a cabeça como junco e em estender debaixo de si saco e cinza? Porventura chamará a isso jejum e dia aceitável a Jeová?

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא זֶה֮ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵהוּ֒ פַּתֵּ֙חַ֙ חַרְצֻבּ֣וֹת רֶ֔שַׁע הַתֵּ֖ר אֲגֻדּ֣וֹת מוֹטָ֑ה וְשַׁלַּ֤ח רְצוּצִים֙ חָפְשִׁ֔ים וְכָל־ מוֹטָ֖ה תְּנַתֵּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w zeh ṣō·wm ’eḇ·ḥā·rê·hū pat·tê·aḥ ḥar·ṣub·bō·wṯ re·ša‘ hat·têr ’ă·ḡud·dō·wṯ mō·w·ṭāh wə·šal·laḥ rə·ṣū·ṣîm ḥā·p̄ə·šîm wə·ḵāl mō·w·ṭāh tə·nat·tê·qū
verses.literal: Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen to break the chains of wickedness to untie the cords of the yoke to set the oppressed free and tear off every yoke
verses.literalPt: Acaso, não é este o jejum que escolhi — romper as ligaduras da iniquidade, desatar as ligaduras do jugo, deixar ir livres os oprimidos e quebrar todo o jugo?

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא פָרֹ֤ס לָֽרָעֵב֙ לַחְמֶ֔ךָ וַעֲנִיִּ֥ים מְרוּדִ֖ים תָּ֣בִיא בָ֑יִת כִּֽי־ תִרְאֶ֤ה עָרֹם֙ וְכִסִּית֔וֹ וּמִבְּשָׂרְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתְעַלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w p̄ā·rōs lā·rā·‘êḇ laḥ·me·ḵā wa·‘ă·nî·yîm mə·rū·ḏîm tā·ḇî ḇā·yiṯ kî- ṯir·’eh ‘ā·rōm wə·ḵis·sî·ṯōw ū·mib·bə·śā·rə·ḵā lō ṯiṯ·‘al·lām
verses.literal: Isn’t it to share your bread with the hungry to bring the poor and homeless into your home to clothe the naked when you see him and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood
verses.literalPt: Acaso, não consiste ele em repartires o teu pão com o faminto e recolheres em casa os pobres desamparados? Em cobrires o nu quando o vires e não te esconderes da tua carne?

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִבָּקַ֤ע כַּשַּׁ֙חַר֙ אוֹרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲרֻכָתְךָ֖ מְהֵרָ֣ה תִצְמָ֑ח וְהָלַ֤ךְ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ צִדְקֶ֔ךָ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה יַאַסְפֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yib·bā·qa‘ kaš·ša·ḥar ’ō·w·re·ḵā wa·’ă·ru·ḵā·ṯə·ḵā mə·hê·rāh ṯiṣ·māḥ wə·hā·laḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ṣiḏ·qe·ḵā kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh ya·’as·p̄e·ḵā
verses.literal: Then your light will break forth like the dawn and your healing will come quickly Your righteousness will go before you and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard
verses.literalPt: Então, romperá a tua luz como a aurora, e depressa nascerá a tua cura; a tua justiça irá diante de ti; a glória de Jeová será a tua retaguarda.

verses.original: אָ֤ז תִּקְרָא֙ וַיהוָ֣ה יַעֲנֶ֔ה תְּשַׁוַּ֖ע וְיֹאמַ֣ר הִנֵּ֑נִי אִם־ תָּסִ֤יר מִתּֽוֹכְךָ֙ מוֹטָ֔ה שְׁלַ֥ח אֶצְבַּ֖ע וְדַבֶּר־ אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz tiq·rā Yah·weh ya·‘ă·neh tə·šaw·wa‘ wə·yō·mar hin·nê·nî ’im- tā·sîr mit·tō·wḵ·ḵā mō·w·ṭāh šə·laḥ ’eṣ·ba‘ wə·ḏab·ber- ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Then you will call and the LORD will answer you will cry out and He will say Here I am If you remove the yoke from your midst the pointing of the finger and malicious talk
verses.literalPt: Então, clamarás, e Jeová responderá; chamarás, e ele dirá: Eis-me aqui. Se tirares do meio de ti o jugo, o estender do dedo e o falar iniquamente;

verses.original: וְתָפֵ֤ק לָֽרָעֵב֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ נַעֲנָ֖ה תַּשְׂבִּ֑יעַ וְזָרַ֤ח בַּחֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ אוֹרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲפֵלָתְךָ֖ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·p̄êq lā·rā·‘êḇ nap̄·še·ḵā wə·ne·p̄eš na·‘ă·nāh taś·bî·a‘ wə·zā·raḥ ba·ḥō·šeḵ ’ō·w·re·ḵā wa·’ă·p̄ê·lā·ṯə·ḵā kaṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul then your light will go forth in the darkness and your night will be like noonday
verses.literalPt: se abrires a tua alma ao faminto e fartares a alma aflita; então, nascerá a tua luz nas trevas, e a tua escuridão tornar-se-á como o meio-dia.

verses.original: וְנָחֲךָ֣ יְהוָה֮ תָּמִיד֒ וְהִשְׂבִּ֤יעַ בְּצַחְצָחוֹת֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְעַצְמֹתֶ֖יךָ יַחֲלִ֑יץ וְהָיִ֙יתָ֙ כְּגַ֣ן רָוֶ֔ה וּכְמוֹצָ֣א מַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יְכַזְּב֖וּ מֵימָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh tā·mîḏ wə·hiś·bî·a‘ bə·ṣaḥ·ṣā·ḥō·wṯ nap̄·še·ḵā wə·‘aṣ·mō·ṯe·ḵā ya·ḥă·lîṣ wə·hā·yî·ṯā kə·ḡan rā·weh ū·ḵə·mō·w·ṣā ma·yim ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḵaz·zə·ḇū mê·māw
verses.literal: The LORD will always guide you He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame You will be like a well-watered garden like a spring . . . whose waters never fail
verses.literalPt: Jeová te guiará continuamente, fartará a tua alma mesmo em lugares áridos e fortificará os teus ossos; serás como um jardim regado e como um manancial de águas cujas águas não falham.

verses.original: וּבָנ֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם מוֹסְדֵ֥י דוֹר־ וָד֖וֹר תְּקוֹמֵ֑ם וְקֹרָ֤א לְךָ֙ גֹּדֵ֣ר פֶּ֔רֶץ מְשֹׁבֵ֥ב נְתִיב֖וֹת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nū mim·mə·ḵā ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām mō·ws·ḏê ḏō·wr- wā·ḏō·wr tə·qō·w·mêm wə·qō·rā lə·ḵā gō·ḏêr pe·reṣ mə·šō·ḇêḇ nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ lā·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: Your people will rebuild the ancient . . . ruins you will restore the age-old foundations you will be called Repairer of the Breach Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling
verses.literalPt: Os que de ti procederem edificarão as antigas ruínas; levantarás os fundamentos de muitas gerações e serás chamado reparador da brecha, restaurador de veredas para que o país se torne habitável.

verses.original: אִם־ תָּשִׁ֤יב מִשַּׁבָּת֙ רַגְלֶ֔ךָ עֲשׂ֥וֹת חֲפָצֶ֖יךָ בְּי֣וֹם קָדְשִׁ֑י וְקָרָ֨אתָ לַשַּׁבָּ֜ת עֹ֗נֶג לִקְד֤וֹשׁ יְהוָה֙ מְכֻבָּ֔ד וְכִבַּדְתּוֹ֙ מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת דְּרָכֶ֔יךָ מִמְּצ֥וֹא חֶפְצְךָ֖ וְדַבֵּ֥ר דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tā·šîḇ miš·šab·bāṯ raḡ·le·ḵā ‘ă·śō·wṯ ḥă·p̄ā·ṣe·ḵā bə·yō·wm qāḏ·šî wə·qā·rā·ṯā laš·šab·bāṯ ‘ō·neḡ liq·ḏō·wōš Yah·weh mə·ḵub·bāḏ wə·ḵib·baḏ·tōw mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ də·rā·ḵe·ḵā mim·mə·ṣō·w ḥep̄·ṣə·ḵā wə·ḏab·bêr dā·ḇār
verses.literal: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath from doing as you please on My holy day if you call the Sabbath a delight and the LORD’s holy day honorable if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words
verses.literalPt: Se apartares do sábado o teu pé e não prosseguires as tuas empresas no meu santo dia, se ao sábado chamares deleitoso, santificado por Jeová e digno de honra; se o honrares, não seguindo os teus caminhos, nem te ocupando nas tuas empresas, nem falando as tuas palavras,

verses.original: אָ֗ז תִּתְעַנַּג֙ עַל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהִרְכַּבְתִּ֖יךָ עַל־ בָּ֣מֳותֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֗יךָ נַחֲלַת֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔יךָ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’āz tiṯ·‘an·naḡ ‘al- Yah·weh wə·hir·kaḇ·tî·ḵā ‘al- bå̄·mo·w·ṯē ’ā·reṣ wə·ha·’ă·ḵal·tî·ḵā na·ḥă·laṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā kî pî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: then you will delight yourself in the LORD and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob For the mouth of the LORD has spoken
verses.literalPt: então, te deleitarás em Jeová. Eu te farei cavalgar sobre as alturas da terra e te alimentarei com a herança de teu pai Jacó, porque a boca de Jeová falou.
